name: Apart Simon Seefeld
beschreibung: Apart Simon Seefeld is situated in a quiet location, and the center of Seefeld in Tirol is within walking distance. The holiday apartments feature a kitchenette, a separate bedroom, and a bathroom. Amenities include satellite TV and Wi-Fi. Most apartment units offer a balcony or a terrace. A parking space and a ski cellar are available. The cross-country ski trails and the ski bus stop are nearby. In summer, the accommodation serves as a starting point for hikes on the Seefelder Plateau.
